title: 636017 Move CashFlow report action tooltips to report objects (W1)
summary: Cash Flow report action tooltips are moved from role center page actions to the report objects themselves, with duplicate tooltips removed from page actions across all country layers.
key_points: Tooltips for Cash Flow Date List and Cash Flow Dimensions Detail reports moved to report object definitions
Duplicate tooltips removed from page actions in Accountant, Accounting Manager, and Finance Manager role centers
Changes propagated to 39 role center page forks and 1 report fork across all country layers
Metadata-only change with no impact on runtime behavior or permissions
Follows established pattern from similar cleanup in Warehouse, Manufacturing, Service, Sales and Inventory areas
quote: Moves the report action ToolTips for the CashFlow reports off the page actions that run them and onto the report objects themselves.
